Start on floor 6 with three hearts. Find five randomly placed coins to unlock each elevator. Your hearts refill to three at every new stage. Descend through five departments, then take the final lift to floor 1 and escape.

01

Follow the gold.

Coins spawn in open spaces, well away from shelves. Explore each unique floor plan to find all five.

02

Lose the guard.

Security follows you around shelves. Keep moving, dodge carts, and use S to brake or reverse.

03

Elevator. One floor down.

Five coins unlock the elevator. Each new stage refills your three hearts. Descend from floor 6 to floor 2, then take the last lift to floor 1 and escape.
